description: Unit test module for Payment Request functionality in ERPNext, including setup, linking, payment entry creation, status checks, and multiple payment requests handling.

classes.name: TestPaymentRequest
classes.description: A unittest.TestCase class testing payment request functionalities such as linking, payment entry creation, status updates, and multiple payment requests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by ensuring payment gateway and accounts exist.

methods.name: test_payment_request_linkings
methods.description: Tests linking of payment requests to sales orders and invoices, including currency and exchange rate handling.

methods.name: test_payment_entry
methods.description: Verifies creation of payment entries, GL entries, and account balances after payment processing.

methods.name: test_status
methods.description: Checks the status transition of payment requests from 'Paid' to 'Requested'.

methods.name: test_multiple_payment_entries_against_sales_order
methods.description: Tests handling multiple payment requests against a single sales order, including validation for overpayment.
